rawContent: Another day in America. Another travesty of justice. #StephonClark was unjustly murdered by Sacramento Police & yet again no one will be held accountable. Sending love to his loved ones & to the activists who have been fighting. #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/d7MtHnUD2F

Another day. Another cop acquitted. Another Black family left grieving again. Even knowing that the system wasn’t set up to bring justice for Black people - we won’t give up. We will work every day to make #BlackLivesMatter. #AntwonRose https://t.co/BL6J0ue1R0
